title: Local LLM benchmark - Mac mini M4 Pro (12-core CPU, 16-core GPU, 24 GB, 512 GB SSD)

methodology.prompt: Explain how a computer CPU works, step by step.
methodology.prompt_api: /api/chat, one system + one user message, streaming
methodology.order: round-robin: all models in round 1, then all in round 2, then all in round 3
per_test_procedure: unload everything and wait until no Ollama runner process exists
LOAD the model (POST /api/generate without prompt, same num_ctx) - timed
warm-up: one raw prompt of similar length, 8 tokens (initialises GPU kernels; not measured)
TEST: the benchmark prompt via streaming /api/chat - measured

metrics.ttft_ms: client-side time from sending the request to receiving the first generated token (answer or reasoning token)
metrics.decode_tokens_per_s: eval_count / eval_duration reported by Ollama (pure generation speed)
metrics.end_to_end_tokens_per_s: generated tokens / total client wall time of the request
metrics.load_time_s: wall time of the load request (reading weights from SSD / OS file cache into GPU memory)
metrics.runner_peak_rss_gib: peak resident memory of the Ollama inference process (llama-server), sampled every 100 ms during load + test; includes the memory-mapped weights
metrics.runner_peak_phys_footprint_gib: peak macOS phys_footprint of the inference process (private memory: KV cache, compute buffers, heap - excludes the mmapped weights)
metrics.ollama_reported_gib: model memory reported by Ollama's /api/ps - reference only, under-reported by Ollama 0.40 for models with a vision projector
metrics.system_used_peak_gib: peak 'Memory Used' of the whole Mac (app + wired + compressed) during load + test

methodology.warmup_prompt: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the sun sets slowly behind the quiet green hills of the old village.
